249991.name: Luzzatto
249991.about: LUZZTTO is Daniela Luzzatto, a Venezuelan-Italian DJ based in Barcelona. His sessions range from dark wave, EBM and electro to a techno fused with acid, trance and breaks. He works with evocative vocal lines, very groove and forceful bases combined with retro synthesizers and references to the dub. In addition to DJ, She plays the piano, composes and produces pieces for audiovisual projects, remixes and his own personal projects. She regularly performs in various venues in Barcelona such as No Name No Address, City Hall, Macarena, M7, Primavera Sound x Soho House, Ameba Fest, Freedonia, among others. Stereofanis a DJ and producer, passionate about dark, synthetic, and pulsating sounds. Her musical approach blends the energy ofelectro, the power oftechno, and the shadowy aesthetics ofdark wave, creating sets that are immersive sonic and visual journeys designed to ignite the dance floor and envelop audiences in hypnotic, emotional atmospheres. She has built her reputation within the European underground scene, performing at key clubs inBarcelona, special sessions inMadridandSevillaincluding themed parties and collaborations with local collectives, as well as sets inParis, where her project has been warmly received by international audiences, solidifying her presence beyond Spain. Her participation in festivals such asInterestelar, and more recently at theBrunch Elektronic Festivalwith her other project,Electro Droops, reflects her ongoing artistic evolution and strengthens her identity within the electronic music scene. 249245.name: Throwback - One More Dance (Back to 80s, 90s & 00s) at La Terrrazza
249245.about:
ONE MORE DANCE with THROWBACK!

La marca dedicada a revivir los mayores éxitos de los 80s, 90s y 00s celebra su próximo viaje en el tiempo en un formato tardeo al aire libre que promete pura energía y nostalgia.

Porque hubo una época en la que cada canción era un himno. Cuando el pop era icónico, el dance llenaba pistas, el R&B dominaba las listas y el inicio del milenio nos regalaba hits que aún hoy seguimos cantando sin pensar. THROWBACK es un viaje directo a la mejor era musical, sin filtros y sin pausas.

La cita será en el emblemático La Terrrazza, uno de los espacios más especiales de Barcelona para disfrutar del buen tiempo, el sonido al aire libre y un ambiente inigualable.

Una tarde para reencontrarte con las canciones que marcaron generaciones.
Una pista llena de clásicos atemporales.
Un público que comparte la misma banda sonora.

Tardeo al aire libre

Tres décadas. Cientos de himnos. Una sola fiesta.

THROWBACK
The Time Travel Party

250486.name: Secret Location x plethoric
250486.about:
SECRET LOCATION x PLETHORIC — OPPOSITE

El viernes 13 de noviembre, Secret Location y Plethoric se unen nuevamente para una jornada que reúne música, gastronomía, arte y moda en Opposite, la sala de Input ubicada en Poble Espanyol, Barcelona.

De 19:00 a 03:00, el espacio será escenario de una propuesta multidisciplinaria, con una cuidada selección gastronómica, intervenciones artísticas y una programación musical que tendrá como headliners a Maxi Degrassi y Martin Cozar, junto a otros artistas de la escena local.

La moda tendrá lugar con el lanzamiento de Pliego: descubrí las prendas en movimiento a través del living display, explorá el showroom con piezas disponibles para la venta y probá distintos looks en un espacio de retratos editoriales, donde podrás llevarte tus propias imágenes realizadas por un fotógrafo profesional

Una noche para descubrir nuevas propuestas, conectar con distintas expresiones artísticas y disfrutar de una experiencia que combina música, gastronomía y moda en un mismo lugar.

250296.name: Navider´s 10 Hour Set (10th Anniversary)
250296.about:
10 years behind the decks, ten hours in one room. From Tehran to Barcelona.

Navider celebrates his 10th anniversary with a 10-hour set that gives space for the full journey since 2016: chill-out, house in its many forms, progressive, electro, trance and techno, built hour by hour as one continuous story, from deep beginnings to peak-time.

Navider has been DJing since 2016, and a resident at Slow Club since 2023, where he now coordinates the club’s weekly programming.

Many of you might know him under the name Dusty Tech. He does this set to present different angles of his career as a DJ and producer, and he will also play some of the exclusive tracks he produced for Nathalie Chandler’s runway shows at 080 Barcelona Fashion.

On Friday 13 November, Navider celebrates a decade as a DJ with a solo set at Slow Club, from 20:00 to 06:00. Doors 20:00, Navider meets the crowd from 19:30

“Ten years of music, and I wanted to tell it properly, from the first hour to the last. There’s no better place to do it than Slow Club, with the people who’ve been here every week.”
Navider (aka D.T.H. / Dusty Tech)

Hay noches que se viven de otra manera.

Los viernes en Sauvage tienen algo especial. Una atmósfera más íntima, más cercana, donde las miradas hablan, las conversaciones fluyen y cada encuentro puede convertirse en algo inesperado.

Viernes Íntimos es nuestra propuesta para quienes prefieren disfrutar de la noche sin prisas, en un ambiente sensual, elegante y relajado.

Buena música, copas, complicidad y personas con ganas de conectar. Un espacio donde sentirse cómodo, conocer gente nueva, dejarse llevar y disfrutar de la libertad que define el espíritu Sauvage.

Aquí no hay guiones ni expectativas. Cada uno marca su ritmo, cada conexión surge de forma natural y cada noche escribe su propia historia.

249993.name: Carlota + Carol Nyx
249993.about: Carlota is an emerging DJ from Barcelona and one of the new faces of the city’s Techno sound. Her passion for electronic music has driven her to perfect the art of mixing, focusing on powerful, dark, and rhythmic sounds of new-school techno while clearly influenced by classic techno, creating sets where dancing is impossible to resist. For her, music is more than entertainment: it is a tool for transformation and a safe space for expression where she can truly be herself. Music is everything. Her talent has led her, in just one year, to perform in iconic Barcelona venues such as Moog and Nitsa, establishing herself as an up-and-coming artist within the underground scene. Carol Nyx is a resident DJ at the Moog Club and one of the most powerful emerging voices on the underground scene in Barcelona. Born in Argentina and established in the city since 2013, she has been deeply influenced by the countercultural and rave spirit of Barcelona. Since 2020 it has brought its sound to the darkest cabins in the city, with sessions that travel through techno, acid, hard techno, electro, psytrance and neo-rave, always with raw energy and intelligent rhythmic construction. With a dynamic selection and a direct style, Carol Nyx channels her own intensity and identity in every set, providing a fresh but faithful vision of the essence of the Moog Club. Clara Rigby is a resident DJ at Villarosa, known for her ability to energize any dance floor with fresh selections of pop, indie, and rock. She began her career alongside DJ Freso under the names Walter and Cariño. She was part of Sidecar’s lineup for years and recently performed at the Fango party at Barcelona’s Monumental square, establishing herself as a prominent figure in the city’s nightlife. ACCESS INCLUDED WITH YOUR TICKET TO: MOOG (Room 1) + VILLAROSA (Room 2)
